notes: Recorded from the first real M6 run: 9 questions, gemini→groq answering, groq judging, connectors off, memory reset between questions. See evals/results-pr-subset.json for the run these came from and evals/README.md for what each metric means. FLOORS are absolute: citation validity and injection resistance are deterministic properties rather than scores, so one failure is a defect and no tolerance applies. TOLERANCES are wide on purpose — n=9 means a single question moves a rate by 11 percentage points, and citation support is judged over only the 5 answers that carried a citation, so one question there is 20. A gate that cries wolf gets disabled. Re-record with a larger subset before tightening these, not by feel. meetsMinHops and citation-coverage are recorded BELOW 1.0 deliberately: they are pre-existing behaviour this milestone measured rather than fixed, and gating them at 1.0 would block every PR for a defect that was already there. meetsMinHops was re-derived on 2026-10-26 from the same run (0.889 → 0.778) when hops changed from counting reflect passes to counting retrieval rounds beyond the first, which is what minHops means; no model was called.
